id.description: Unique identifier for the card definition (e.g., villager, iron_sword).

nameTerm.description: Localization token resolving to the localized card name.

descriptionTerm.description: Localization token resolving to rules text and descriptive lore.

script.description: Optional class identifier mapped to execution controller (e.g. CombatableWorker).

icon.description: Relative file path to an external .png texture or existing icon asset.

value.description: Base economic value in gold coins; -1 designates unsellable items.

cardLimitCost.description: Weight contributed toward the board population cap.

dynamicProperties.description: Key-value store exposing component variables to the simulation (e.g., _FoodValue, _CombatTier).
